note: NOT the shipped floor; evidence for a pending decision. The same derivation as planner_floor.json, but every row at 3000 replicates (seeds 20261014, 20261015 and 20261016 pooled, 1000 each, --draws 4999), plus the boundary accuracies 0.995, 0.999 and 1.0 and asymmetric TPR 0.95 with TNR 0.99 to 1.0, tested for under-coverage only above 0.99. At this power the interval is shown to under-cover where a class shows about 2 to 3 errors (0.88 at 20, 0.90 at 28, 0.92 at 35, 0.95 at 61, 0.98 at 130, 0.99 at 260) and at prevalence 0.02 with 100 eval traces, so no size qualifies at 0.99.
